description_short: The Asia Research Institute at NUS invites PhD students who have completed fieldwork and recent PhD recipients to apply to its 22nd Singapore Graduate Forum on Southeast Asian Studies, held online 7-11 June and at NUS 14-18 June 2027. Applications close 4 December 2026.
